title: Site Dashboard and Field History refinements
changes: Improved Site Dashboard network presentation and theme readability.
Improved equipment replacement entry sizing and validation while keeping serial numbers optional.
Cleaned up submitted write-up formatting, including Ping Stats, equipment replacements, and VSWR ratios.
Improved the New Ticket Assigned To dropdown across application themes.
Added smooth scrolling for long submitted write-ups in Field Technician History.

title: Write-up and request dialog fixes
changes: Improved the Request Ticket, Request Capital, and Request Maintenance dialog layout.
Added all assigned technicians to the submitted write-up technician footer.
Ensured completed work appears in each participating technician's History.
Added all participating technicians as write-up email recipients.

title: Site History Edit/Delete Button
changes: Found left over Edit and Delete buttons on Site History. Removed them.

title: Local SNMP polling fix
changes: Changed SNMP GET and SET operations to run directly from the client laptop instead of the API server.
Kept SNMP profiles, credentials, OIDs, formulas, and decode mappings centrally managed by the API.
Restored SNMP polling for cached dashboards when the API server cannot directly reach field radio networks.
Fixed SNMP profile selection so the current profile is preserved and matched to the site's communication type.
Verified single OID polling, Poll All, and SNMP SET operations from cached site dashboards.

title: Parent database resilience and complete offline fallback
changes: Added complete last-known Parent database caching for AMS/MR, DACS, IGSD, Range Extender, tower, and tower-sector data.
Added automatic live-to-cache fallback when the Parent database is unavailable.
Added Limited Mode when the Parent database is unavailable and no cached site data exists.
Added cached tower searching and complete cached tower dashboards.
Added a transactional cache refresh process that preserves the previous cache if a refresh fails.
Added an automatic weekly cache refresh scheduled for Sunday at 2:00 AM.
Kept ping diagnostics, SNMP tools, tickets, notes, Site History, and write-up submission available during Parent database outages.
Added the correct AMS/MR, IG, DACS, and Range Extender layouts in Limited Mode.
Restored the Portal tab for IG and DACS dashboards in Limited Mode.
Moved Site Dashboard status messages above the Pop-Out button.
Improved cached-data status messages and timestamps.
Changed the default Interface Size setting to 100%.

title: Display scaling improvements
changes: Added automatic interface scaling for docked external monitors.
Added an Interface Size selector with automatic and manual sizing options.
Kept the Module Launcher, About App, and Bug / Feature Request windows at their original sizes.
Improved Smart Grid Suite readability on monitors configured at 100% Windows scaling.

title: Update Corruption
changes: Removed Duplicate App Manifest asInvoker privileges.

title: Update Corruption
changes: Packaged and uploaded new version due to 1.0.0.6 update file corruption.

title: Windows DPI Aware, sizing issues.
changes: Allows WPF to react when window moves between monitors w/ different DPI settings.
Corrected sizing Dispatch->Technician Truck cards. Optimized for laptop screens.

title: Text Correction, Admin-> Tech-> Add Tech
changes: Correct Text color on Dispatch->Tickets Details and Dispatch->Tasks Details
Corrected Admin->Tech-> Add Tech Window to be themed. Changed Border Color.
Corrected DataGrid in Admin->SNMP->Add OID to be themed.

title: Tickets & Themes
changes: Finished up the colors on themes. You're welcome David
Corrected Theme Controls
Got rid of the 'Design Test' in the admin window.
Flip-flopped CNP Logo Image depending on Theme (white font, black font).
Ensured application opens Landing Page after each module is closed and ensured app shuts down after exiting Landing Page.
Updated Dispatch -> Tickets Search Debounce from 250ms to 650ms.
Added Loading Overlay when searching Tickets.
Added option to delete ticket while holding onto Site History associated (API, Contracts & Client).
Corrected first Daily Assignment Email doesn't say 'Modified'. Every email after that in the same calendar day says 'Modified'.

title: Client -> API Connection Updates
changes: Corrected Https:// to http:// in ClientAppSettings.

title: Deployment and version management
changes: Added automatic ClickOnce update support.
Added installed, latest, and minimum-supported version checking.
The launcher now expands when a connectivity warning is displayed.
Smart Grid Suite can now be installed and updated from the central server.

title: Launcher and support-window cleanup
changes: About and Bug / Feature Request were moved into dedicated XAML windows.
About was redesigned with company branding and a more compact layout.
Change Log was moved into its own dedicated window.
Bug / Feature Request now generates a structured clipboard template.

title: Dispatch, General Settings, and Site Dashboard updates
changes: Communication Device Types can now be added, edited, deleted, and managed from General Settings.
Dispatch can copy selected Work Orders as a vertical list for Excel and time entry.
Work Order length protection was added across the UI, API, and database.
Dispatch can edit technician write-ups from the task details pane.
Site Dashboard write-up typing performance was improved.
